types.name: ScrollAreaEdges
types.doc: Which edges still have content beyond them.

types.name: ScrollAreaProps
types.doc: A native scroll container with thin overlay scrollbars that appear while scrolling or on hover and fade away at rest. Each edge fades out only when there is more content beyond it, in proportion to how much. Scrolling stays native, so keyboard, touch momentum, and scroll snap all behave as the platform expects.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: Axes that scroll. Defaults to vertical.

members.name: fade
members.doc: Length of the edge fade in px. 0 turns the fades off.

members.name: scrollbars
members.doc: "auto" shows scrollbars while scrolling or hovering; "always" keeps them visible when content overflows.

members.name: hideDelay
members.doc: How long scrollbars linger after scrolling stops, in ms.

members.name: maxHeight
members.doc: Maximum height of the viewport, for vertical areas that should grow with their content.

members.name: snap
members.doc: Passed to the viewport's `scroll-snap-type`, for example "x mandatory". Children set their own `scroll-snap-align`.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name. The viewport becomes a labelled, focusable region that arrow and page keys scroll.

members.name: wheelToHorizontal
members.doc: Turns vertical wheel movement into horizontal scrolling for horizontal areas. Defaults to true.

members.name: onEdgeChange
members.doc: Called when content starts or stops extending past an edge.
